name: cube
title: CUBE (Wouter van Oortmerssen, 2005_08_29: C++ on SDL 1.2, SDL_image, SDL_mixer and OpenGL, ENet)
fetch: cube_2005_08_29_src.zip from SourceForge (sourceforge.net/projects/cube), its cube_source/ unpacked as corpus/cube_2005_08_29; the data is cube_2005_08_29_unix.tar.gz's cube/ (~/games/cube/files/cube)
_units: src/Makefile's CLIENT_OBJS, and the ENet library it links: enet/Makefile.am's libenet_a_SOURCES less win32.c, which is all inside #ifdef WIN32. include/ and lib/ are the Windows build's SDL and fmod: the Unix build takes SDL from sdl-config, so they are not on the include path.
_generated: zlib, which the Makefile links as -lz, compiled from the zlib 1.1.3 tree MAME 0.37b5 already uses (its .cgz maps are gzip files read through gzread).
_defines: What the Makefile's flags say: -fsigned-char (char is signed on i386 anyway), no NDEBUG.
